annotations.text:
PICK A COLOUR SYSTEM.

Same words, same three projects, four different systems. Compare them like-for-like, then tell me a letter.

Each one carries a UX posture too, not just a palette - how much structure comes from borders vs. spacing, how loud the buttons are, how much the page decorates itself.

Every one names its own downside at the bottom of the frame. None of them is free.

WHY THIS INSTEAD OF ANOTHER FULL PAGE.

I chose the palette for you three times and got it wrong three times. Cream, orange and yellow with hard black borders and tilted cards was a bad call - loud, dated, and it made every section shout at the same volume.

So: pick the system first, then I build the whole page once, in that system. Nothing else changes - the eight years, the AI section and the writing all carry over.
